title: Myth Or Fact (demo)
sources: DEMO ONLY, engine test; claims are common examples, check 2 sources before publishing any real claim

lines.text: Think you know the truth? Let's test three claims!
Lightning never strikes the same place twice. Myth! Tall buildings get hit many times a year.
Honey never goes bad. Fact! Sealed honey can last for years.
Goldfish remember for only three seconds. Myth! They can remember for weeks.
Which one surprised you? Comment below!
